# proof

<!-- Generated by nightseam from proof/proof/; do not edit. -->

A family of the `nightseam.duplex/1` profile, declared in `proof/proof/model.json`, `proof/proof/protocol.json`.
It imports `probe`.
The tiers it declares bring the built-in family `duplex`, imported implicitly.

## Parameters

The family is instantiated by filling these parameters:

- **S**: a family with the `protocol` tier, drawn at `Envelope`, `Handle`. Any family that carries the protocol tier, whose messages this one relays.
- **Item**: a type. What a page of this family's own listing holds: a type parameter beside a family parameter, on one declaration.

## Carried types

These are this family's own types, declared in the same language by a built-in family Nightseam declares of itself and imported by the tier that brings it, with no `imports` line. A declaration of this family may not declare one and names it by the built-in that declares it — `duplex.Envelope`.

### Envelope

A record, carried from the built-in `duplex` family. One message of the nightseam.duplex/1 profile: the members the peer acts on, and nothing else.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `integer` | required | — | The profile's version, 1. |
| `kind` | `string` | required | — | request, response, event or cancel. |
| `id` | `string` | optional | — | What correlates a response or a cancel with its request. |
| `method` | `string` | optional | — | The method a request names. |
| `params` | `json` | optional | — | A request's parameters. |
| `result` | `json` | optional | — | A response's result. |
| `error` | `json` | optional | — | A response's error. |
| `event` | `string` | optional | — | The event an event frame names. |
| `data` | `json` | optional | — | An event's data. |
| `traceparent` | `string` | optional | — | The W3C Trace Context of the frame. |
| `tracestate` | `string` | optional | — | The vendor state of that trace. |
| `meta` | map of `string` | optional | — | What a request or an event carries about the call, delivered to the handler beside the payload. |

### Handle

A record, carried from the built-in `duplex` family. A reference to a channel on the connection that carries the message holding it.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | `integer` | required | — | The channel's id on that connection. |

## Server side

The server implements these methods and emits these events.

Extends the server side of `probe`.

| Method | Request | Result | Errors | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `echo` | `probe.Payload` | `probe.Payload` | `denied` | Inherited from `probe`. Returns the payload. |
| `parts` | `PartsRequest` | `Result` with E=`string`, T=`Parts` | — | The parts of a message, or why there are none. |
| `relay` | `Carried` | `Option` with T=`Envelope` | — | Relays one message of S. |

| Event | Data | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `changed` | `probe.Payload` | Inherited from `probe`. A payload changed. |
| `part.added` | `RichPart` | A part was added. |

### `echo` on the wire

The client sends:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "id": "c:1",
  "method": "echo",
  "params": {
    "text": "‹text›"
  }
}
```

The server answers:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "result": {
    "text": "‹text›"
  }
}
```

Or refuses with `denied`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "error": {
    "code": "denied",
    "message": "The caller is denied."
  }
}
```

### `parts` on the wire

The client sends:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "id": "c:1",
  "method": "parts",
  "params": {
    "after": "‹after›"
  }
}
```

The server answers:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "result": {
    "kind": "err",
    "value": "‹err›"
  }
}
```

### `relay` on the wire

The client sends:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "id": "c:1",
  "method": "relay",
  "params": {
    "message": "‹S.Envelope›",
    "back": "‹S.Handle›",
    "page": {
      "items": [
        "‹Item›"
      ],
      "next": "‹next›"
    }
  }
}
```

The server answers:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "id": "c:1",
  "result": {
    "kind": "none",
    "value": {}
  }
}
```

The server emits:

```json
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "event",

  "data": {
    "text": "‹text›"

```
